steps.note: S1.3.1.1 tracks the scratch vectors a,c through rows 0-1, 2-5 and 6-7 and concludes the net target change is (JV+RG)x independently of a,c, quoting line 748.
S1.3.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, and self coefficient one.
S1.3.1.3 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero and self coefficient one.
S1.3.1.4 states the inverse schedule effects X<-X-Y, the stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and that each invocation restores its own auxiliary wires.
The plan says every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels (S1.3.3.4) but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals and their dimensions, i.e. the residual table.

S1.3.3.3 states the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y (quoting the label construction at line 953), but not the edge-2->5 residual <t_X,t_Y>^perp or its dimension h-2, so only half of the defining content is there.
The plan states the only decreasing edges are center 3->4 losing h, source dimensions N and sink dimensions Wm-N, gate-wise telescoping to Wm-2N, and the absolute budget adding 2L.

S1.3.3.6 states that over F_2 every nonzero residual contains a norm-one vector, so it is nondegenerate and nonalternating and has an orthonormal basis; it compresses the reason for nondegeneracy and leaves out the plane-absorption argument, but nothing it says contradicts the paper.
S1.3.3.7 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly.
S1.3.5.1 gives the weight identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U as a sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis of the residual.
S1.3.5.2 states each basis vector has odd weight, giving the phase i^{+-[v.x]} split as a character, and H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into aI+bX_v or its inverse.

The plan counts s_c kernels for one column (S1.3.5) and s_c slot children (S1.5.1), but never says that on k columns the frames tensor and each residual vector gives one tensored factor acting on all columns; the plan's nearby steps imply this without stating it.

S1.5.1.5 names the source and sink Z signs, the scalar i^{27f} and the negation of the X bank, but not the endpoint computation behind them: frame I for the zero label and C^{tensor m} for the full label, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) on X_a->Y_a, and C=iZC^{-1}Z.
The plan states both loss ratios are below 1/2, the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, and hence s<Wm for both networks.
S1.3.6 gives the bit relative deficit 339/22587335000000.
S1.3.6 gives the complex relative deficit 73/19906842167500.
S1.3.6 states both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, that log m<20, that m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}), and hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, quoting line 1331.

S1.3.7.1 describes elimination from the topmost nonzero row's rightmost pivot by lower-triangular operations, one rank-one block per step on the remaining active submatrix, giving exactly a ones in Pi.

S1.3.7 only says in parentheses that q is a fixed odd prime avoiding all denominators; it never mentions the finite table of factors, or that the identities then specialize to Z/q^b with the triangular factors still invertible.
S1.3.7.2 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order from still-unchanged earlier coordinates.
S1.3.7.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, one interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, so the interchange count is exactly a.
The plan gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, m^{10}<B<m^{11} and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{20}), but never defines C_0=128mB^2, nu or the rule C_1=max{20,nu+3}, so the set of constants is incomplete.
S1.5.4's method states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, and S1.5.4.1 states that each invocation adds at most E operations and that leaves need at most 8e.
S1.5.4.1 asserts the resulting depth bound 8B^2 d^{12} but states neither the unrolling inequality B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu nor the bound of the total, pieces and phases included, below C_0 d^{C_1}.
S1.5.4.2 gives values at depth ell in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^ell and the p+Delta / Delta+3 bit reservation, and S1.5.4.3 gives 20 epsilon<1 hence Delta=o(p).
S1.5.5 states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the single final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P01 is present on 19 of the 26 sub-steps and wrong on none. All of B1-B4, R1-R4, P1-P2, M1, M3-M4, L3-L5, S2, S4 and S5 are present. Absent: L1 (no residual table), L2 (inclusion without the h-2 residual), P3 (no tensoring over columns), P4 (endpoint corrections named without the endpoint computation), M2 (prime named without the specialization argument), S1 (C_0, nu and C_1 not defined) and S3 (depth bound asserted without the unrolling or the total below C_0 d^{C_1}).
